description: Search builder communities — the Slack workspaces, WhatsApp groups and meetups that independent builders actually gather in — by free text, region, topic and platform. Each result carries a real join link. Call this when someone wants to reach a scene rather than a person: where founders in a given country talk to each other, which group covers a topic, where to go to meet builders in a region. Do not call it to find products or their builders — that is search_products. Communities and products are separate records; a community is a group of people, not something someone shipped. Member counts appear only where the organisers stated one, so a null count means unknown, not small.

query.description: Free text matched against name and one-liner.

region.description: Country name, e.g. "Israel", "United States", "Nigeria". Case-insensitive. Omit for all regions.

name: search_communities
title: Search communities
